currentRoundInspection.scope: Basilica of Santa Croce connected church exterior plus its separate integral campanile: long raised nave with tiled gable, repeated lower side-aisle gables, transept, rear chapels/polygonal apse, marble three-part western facade with rose and geometric green/pink inlay, three real recessed wooden portals and broad supported entrance treads, pinnacles and a tall pointed belfry/spire. Actual parent and32 integral mapped building parts control scale; the campanile has its own actual footprint. The separately mapped convent/cloisters, Pazzi Chapel, refectory and neighboring city buildings remain independent. No copied sculpture, frescoes, tombs, text or furnished interiors.
